summary: registry-facts is a zero-dependency Python CLI that turns the Sourcey open registry's current release into verifiable, paste-ready dated facts. company/readiness/search subcommands emit Reddit-shaped answers that always carry provenance: dataset URL, release digest, and retrieval date — e.g. 'Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 Public DNS holds grade A+ for agent onboarding (release 8094c042ec14; retrieved 2026-10-02)'. Live-verified 2026-10-02: all three Sourcey datasets (companies 543 records, startup-credits, agent-readiness 25 profiles) resolve to release sha256:8094c042ec143bbd5d47c59219c4f4abb189db6368c4a51f37a862963f9a4580; company devin, readiness cloudflare (2 profiles: Developer Platform C+, Public DNS A+), search 'AI', and releases subcommands all exercised successfully with table/reddit/json formats.
author: AmirDiaz
